biological_reference.closest_mechanism: gain control in cortico-basal-ganglia salience arbitration; divisive normalisation (Carandini & Heeger canonical normalisation computation; in BG via lateral inhibition / FSI-mediated pooling)
biological_reference.divergence: SalienceCoordinator.tick() (ree_core/cingulate/salience_coordinator.py:455-467) applies a HARD CLIP, max(-cap, min(cap, value)), per input signal before its per-mode weight, while external_task_bias is added to the external_task logit UNCLAMPED. Hard clipping is scale-sensitive by construction; biological divisive normalisation is scale-FREE by construction. Every difficulty in this lineage -- the bimodal baseline_margin distribution, per-agent saturation, the need for a free per-agent constant at all, and the fact that a RATIO rule under-corrects (a clip does not divide, so dividing the threshold cannot undo it) -- is the predictable consequence of that substitution. A normalising gain stage would remove the free parameter entirely: there would be no r to pre-register. LOAD-BEARING, not a caveat.

fanout_recommendation.note: GOV-FANOUT-1 does not apply as a NEW portfolio. The bottleneck is not a live discrimination among rivals -- it is a single, named, unambiguous corrective re-queue whose target value the run's own data already measured. The existing question mech266_mode_arbitration_saturation does gain one new leg (H4-clip-not-normalisation) via labelled FANOUT-GROWTH, recorded in hypothesis_space_ledger below, but that is denominator growth on an existing question rather than a new discrimination portfolio.

learning_extracted: An aliasing control that is not wired into the routing does not control aliasing. The driver identified the H-IDIO/H-KNIFE hazard, built the exact instrument to resolve it, recorded the readout, and then routed through an `else` that never reads it. Any pre-registered aliasing control should have a NAMED BRANCH in the routing, not an INFO_ONLY field.

A hardcoded route_reason on a fall-through branch will eventually be false. This is the second false route_reason in this lineage in five days (2026-08-13: `external_task_mode_not_occupied` emitted while the mode was 100% occupied). Reasons should be derived from which criterion actually failed.

A constant imported from a prior run inherits that run's reproducibility, not just its arithmetic. R_STAR's derivation was sound arithmetic on a seed->margin mapping that did not survive a 3-commit substrate move. A pre-registered constant carried across a substrate change needs its basis re-verified against substrate_hash, not asserted in prose.

A 'narrow band' observed on a coarse grid may be an artefact of the grid. V3-EXQ-934's r band 2.22-2.28 came from two cap values at the ENDS of a 5-point absolute grid intersected with a bimodal margin distribution; V3-EXQ-935's finer sweep put the real graded window entirely ABOVE it.

Scale-normalisation retrofitted onto a hard clip is fighting the gain stage. The biological mechanism (divisive normalisation) is scale-free by construction and needs no per-agent constant; every calibration difficulty in this lineage is downstream of substituting a clip for a division.

The 'mixed regime' in this lineage is two-mode, not four: internal_replay and offline_consolidation were 0 in all 35 cells. Any successor's regime claim must be bounded to external_task vs internal_planning.

Extend the sweep upward (e.g. 2.25 / 2.45 / 2.65 / 2.85 / 3.05) so the graded window's UPPER edge is measured and a seed-42-class agent (needs r > 2.65) gets a tested r instead of falling off the end.
Run on FRESH out-of-sample seeds (e.g. 47-51). r = 2.45 is in-sample on 42-46; the common-rule claim must be re-earned on seeds that did not choose it.

Wire H-KNIFE into the routing: an explicit branch firing when C1 fails at R_STAR AND some single common r in the sweep clears MIN_FRACTION, routing `rule_right_r_wrong_requeue`. H-IDIO must require that NO swept r clears. Never fall through to H-IDIO while the sweep contains a clearing r.
Derive route_reason from the actually-failing criterion instead of hardcoding it per branch.
Re-verify or drop the 'this exact substrate' claim in ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_EXEMPT; gate it on substrate_hash equality rather than prose.
Report internal_replay / offline_consolidation occupancy so the regime claim is bounded to the two modes actually exercised.

The skill permits either 'prefer a different family' or 'state explicitly why this leg is not the dead one wearing a new name'; the second is taken in full in H4's basis (H4 PRESUPPOSES H2's refutation and concerns the gain stage upstream of the register, not the register). Read it as: the leg is defensible, the campaign is not converging.
